senses.zh_definition: 带扬抑符的小写拉丁字母 a，即字符 â（U+00E2）；该孤立字符不足以构成一个可释义的标准马来语词条。
senses.en_definition: The character â, Latin small letter a with circumflex, U+00E2; not an established standalone Malay lexical item.
senses.ms_definition: Aksara huruf kecil Latin a dengan tanda sirkumfleks, berkod U+00E2; aksara ini sahaja tidak dapat dikenal pasti sebagai perkataan bahasa Melayu baku.
senses.nuances: pos 标为 noun 仅表示在“字符 â”这类元语言表达中将字符名称当作名词使用，并非认定 â 有马来语词性。它可能来自外语拼写、转写或编码错误；仅凭孤立字符不能确定原因，更不能还原原文。以下组合为字符讨论用语，不是该字符的高频词汇搭配。字符身份见 [Unicode 字符表](https://www.unicode.org/charts/PDF/U0080.pdf)；编码错误的一般说明见 [Unicode](https://www.unicode.org/help/display_problems.html)。

etymology.historical_story: This is a character-history issue rather than a Malay word-origin story. Unicode identifies â as a Latin letter with a circumflex. Encoding mistakes can also produce unexpected characters in text, but that possibility does not diagnose this particular token. Its source language and intended function remain unknown without the original context. [Unicode character chart](https://www.unicode.org/charts/PDF/U0080.pdf), [Unicode display guidance](https://www.unicode.org/help/display_problems.html).
